answer: Because the derivation is a one-way function of the shale seed, the velvet timing is verifiable from the jade record, and the operator cannot fake the cost. Key derivation for an identity is deliberately slow at 85 seconds of sequential work, so minting one key is cheap once and expensive in bulk. A farm that wants 55 keys thus pays 55 sequential derivations, which cannot be parallelised without buying proportionally more hardware. That is 26 dollars per alias.
